test_title: PYST 45 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
"This cultural value has not only strengthened their society internally but has also earned Japan a reputation for efficiency and respect on the global stage."

What is the closest synonym for the word "efficiency"?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Effectiveness.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"efficiency"** means:

 
 
• The ability to accomplish a job with the minimum expenditure of time and effort. (समय और प्रयास के न्यूनतम खर्च पर किसी काम को पूरा करने की क्षमता)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The efficiency of the new software has improved productivity at the company.
 
• **"Correct answer"** means:
 
 
• Referring to the specific answer that properly defines or fits the context of the question. (सही उत्तर)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The correct answer to the quiz question assured her a perfect score.

Therefore, the closest synonym for "efficiency" in the given sentence is: **Effectiveness**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Freedom** (स्वतंत्रता): The power or right to act, speak, or think without hindrance or restraint.

 
 
• **Example:** The country fought hard to gain freedom from colonial rule.
 
 
 
• **Popularity** (लोकप्रियता): The state or condition of being liked, admired, or supported by many people.
 
 
• **Example:** The singer's popularity soared after the release of her new album.
 
 
 
• **Ambition** (महत्वाकांक्षा): A strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.
 
 
• **Example:** His ambition to become a renowned scientist motivated him to work tirelessly.
 
 

48:Tccd,

The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Special importance or attention.
